Effects of ZrO2 and Al2O3 Addition on the Physical Properties of Cu-Mo-Cr Alloy  
by Liquid Phase Sintering
In this study, the effect of the addition of ZrO2 and Al2O3 ceramic powders to Cu-Mo-Cr alloy was studied by examining the 
physical properties of the composite material. The ceramic additives were selected based on the thermodynamic stability calculation 
of the Cu-Mo-Cr alloys. Elemental powders, in the ratio Cu:Mo:Cr = 60:30:10 (wt.%), and approximately 0-1.2 wt.% of ZrO2 and 
Al2O3 were mixed, and a green compact was formed by pressing the mixture under 186 MPa pressure and sintering at 1250°C for
